exposure: Diagnosis of inflammatory bowel disease, celiac disease, or liver disease
Women without a diagnosis of inflammatory bowel disease, celiac disease, or liver disease
Women with endoscopy <1 year before or after pregnancy
Timing of endoscopy relative to pregnancy (<1 year before/after vs during)
Endoscopy exposure within the same mother
cohort: Pregnant women in Sweden from 1992 through 2011
finding: Endoscopy during pregnancy was associated with an increased risk of preterm birth and small for gestational age, but not congenital malformations or stillbirth.
